hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qE 'biome-ignore|eslint-disable' "$f"; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Lint suppression comments (biome-ignore, eslint-disable) are not allowed. Fix the lint issue properly instead of suppressing it."}'; else echo '{}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qE "\"off\"" "$f"; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Setting rules to off in biome.json is not allowed. Fix the code to satisfy the rule instead."}'; else echo '{}'; fi; }
hooks.statusMessage: Checking biome config for off rules...
